attention_subtype_map.causal_path: For FP8 KV cache, TritonAttnBackend.forward_extend clones local K and V only because set_kv_buffer scales them in place before _fwd_kernel consumes the originals. Enqueueing the local cache quantize/store after _fwd_kernel preserves same-stream ordering and removes both full-tensor clones without gathering KV or changing model/kernel geometry.

attribution.attribution_rule: Every wall interval is assigned once. Concurrent GPU intervals use the longest active kernel; idle intervals use active CUDA synchronization/launch APIs, then scheduler_gap.

phases.split_rule: Non-overlapping median-TTFT proxy: prefill ends at the median first-token timestamp; the remainder is decode.

causal_model.intervention: Route only M>128,K=5376,N=43008 to a 64x256x128 eight-warp Triton tile; preserve stock CUTLASS for decode and every other shape.

intervention.causal_falsifier: Close the attempt if the exact stacked endpoint candidate does not improve its contemporaneous control or fails semantic, accounting, FP8, QKV, retained-attention, or exact-shape invocation proof.

counter_diagnostic.reason: The retained launch sequence, behavioral FP8 shape audit, launch footprint, and pinned dispatch source identify one exact dominant shape and its one-CTA-per-SM realization without another GPU invocation.

intervention.source_justification: The retained 14,400-launch 128x128x128 CUTLASS family is exactly 60 repetitions of the 60-layer qkv/o/gate_up/down order. Gate/up is 3,600 launches and 2.192004724 seconds (44.79599% of this family), with exact K=5,376 and N=43,008. The M>128 persistent kernel uses a 132-CTA grid, 384 threads, 214,016 bytes of dynamic shared memory and 168 registers/thread, allowing only one high-footprint CTA per H200 SM. The candidate changes only this gate/up subtype to a 64x256x128 eight-warp/four-stage tile, increasing contiguous N work per program while reducing M tile height; every decode and non-gate/up shape retains pinned CUTLASS.
